title: 1801 Prairie's corner turret gets its turned finial
items: The small round turret at the east end of the Kimball house's 18th Street side now ends the way the c. 1895 photograph shows it: the slate stops at a rim, and a smooth sweep rises from it into a slender finial with two knobs and a spike.
Until now the cone ran up to a plain point with a bare spike on it.
